structured_output.mechanisms: Time scales with total samples processed (steps × batch) times a per-sample cost that grows with the later-stage channel widths. Small batches add a little overhead. Cutout adds a little. Low-res early phase via resizing cuts time about 16% but costs about 0.5 points of accuracy. Accuracy rises logarithmically with epochs, falls with narrower nets, cutout, random flip and zero or heavy label smoothing, and rises slightly with weaker translation.
